characters.name: Aconit
characters.visual_description: Predominantly botanical monkshood flower-woman with a lightly humanized cool-blue face nested inside a tall cobalt aconite hood, narrow expressive indigo eyes, petal planes instead of human hair, sharp leaf-and-vine limbs and no visible human skin texture
characters.wardrobe: Her severe silhouette is formed entirely by overlapping indigo petals, a pointed blue monkshood hood and a dark silver-green leaf collar, with no ordinary fabric clothing, shoes or human accessories
signature_details: single silver crescent marking beneath the left eye
two small blue aconite blossoms growing from the right shoulder vine
wants: keep the greenhouse and Belladone alive
identify the sender of the forbidden inheritance
fears: being understood too clearly by Belladone
characters.voice_description: Low precise French mezzo voice, restrained breath, dry timing and warmth carefully hidden under authority
characters.generation_negative_prompt: photorealistic human woman, human skin pores, human ears, human hair, ordinary blue gown, separate helmet, purple dominant palette, round soft silhouette, smiling broadly without narrative cause

characters.name: Belladone
characters.visual_description: Predominantly botanical flower-woman with a lightly humanized lavender face emerging from a broad deep-plum belladonna corolla, large expressive violet eyes, petal curls instead of human hair, leaf-and-vine limbs and no visible human skin texture
characters.wardrobe: Her silhouette is formed entirely by layered plum petals, dark olive sepals and flexible climbing vines, with no ordinary fabric clothing, shoes or human accessories
signature_details: tiny black heart marking under the right eye
cluster of exactly three glossy black belladonna berries at the left hip
purple heart-shaped nectar gem at the throat
wants: transform every danger into a game
make Aconit admit that she cares
discover why the forbidden inheritance chose them
fears: being treated like a fragile ornamental flower
revealing sincere attachment before Aconit does
characters.voice_description: Warm playful French contralto, smiling diction, intimate delivery and a dangerous little laugh
characters.generation_negative_prompt: photorealistic human woman, human skin pores, human ears, human hair, ordinary dress, realistic hands, separate hat, red palette, more or fewer than three signature berries

characters.name: La Graine Noire
characters.visual_description: A glossy black botanical seed shaped like a small anatomical heart, split by one thin violet seam, with tiny rootlets like veins and no human face, limbs or readable species
characters.wardrobe: Its only covering is a wet obsidian shell with a subtle violet inner glow and delicate vein-like roots that move with deliberate intelligence
wants: force Belladone and Aconit to reveal what binds them
characters.voice_description: Tiny sexless French whisper doubled by a low subterranean resonance, intimate and unnervingly amused
characters.generation_negative_prompt: cute baby face, eyes, mouth, humanoid body, ordinary bean, bright cheerful green, gore, blood, oversized monster

locations.name: La Serre
locations.visual_description: A vast nocturnal Victorian poison greenhouse with black wrought-iron ribs, fogged glass panes, a huge moon beyond the roof, tangled sentient vines, toxic bell flowers, blue aconites and a round veined marble pedestal at its center
signature_details: black wrought-iron arches shaped like thorns
round veined marble pedestal at the center
huge moon visible through fogged roof glass
poison flowers that subtly turn toward whoever is speaking
locations.generation_negative_prompt: daylight, modern furniture, clean laboratory, sunny garden, ordinary greenhouse, photorealistic people, readable signs, text, logos, gore

relationships.label: Désir nié sous surveillance
relationships.summary: Belladone provoque Aconit pour obtenir un aveu; Aconit protège Belladone tout en refusant de nommer son attachement.

relationships.label: Emprise antagoniste
relationships.summary: La Graine Noire exploite les dénis de Belladone sans que cette contrainte soit présentée comme romantique.

art_direction.summary: Fantaisie botanique gothique stylisée, lisible sur écran vertical, où les silhouettes végétales et la lumière racontent avant le dialogue.
visual_style: formes végétales majoritaires et visages légèrement humanisés
composition verticale avec sujet lisible au centre
rendering_rules: Conserver les marqueurs botaniques et détails signatures entre les plans.
Réserver le premier plan et les contrastes forts au beat narratif actif.
Éviter tout texte généré dans image et toute marque visible.
banned_elements: changement silencieux de silhouette ou de palette

tone.summary: Romance sombre comique: désir contrarié, menace réelle et reparties sèches, sans confondre danger et consentement.
dialogue_rules: Une réplique courte doit modifier le rapport de force ou révéler un déni.
Belladone masque sa vulnérabilité par la provocation; Aconit par la précision sèche.
Laisser des silences et réactions visuelles; ne pas expliquer ce que le plan montre.
content_boundaries: Ne jamais romantiser la coercition, emprise ou violence.
Aucune référence, imitation ou continuité issue de propriété tierce.

world_rules.statement: Tout usage de poison a un coût visible, une limite ou une conséquence narrative.
La serre réagit aux mensonges et vérités émotionnelles sans révéler seule un secret canonique.
Aucun changement de relation ou de canon généré ne devient définitif sans validation humaine.

narrative_arcs.title: Héritage interdit
narrative_arcs.summary: Belladone et Aconit doivent comprendre pourquoi la Graine Noire les a choisies tandis que leurs dénis la nourrissent.
beats: Une vérité librement dite peut interrompre sa germination.

secrets.summary: Aconit reconnaît un symbole ancien sur la Graine Noire mais cache encore ce souvenir à Belladone.
